name: Stone of the True Form (Thaumaturgical Ritual, Advanced)

system.description: By coating a small pebble in a Blood Trait, the thaumaturge creates a single-use talisman that, upon successfully touching a shapeshifting creature (possibly requiring a Physical Challenge), forces it back into its natural form for one scene - Garou revert to breed form, Gangrel lose their Protean shape, Nosferatu lose Mask of a Thousand Faces, and Tzimisce revert to their Embrace-form.
